intro: Trying to find USA scholarships for international students with September timing usually means balancing urgency with fit. This filtered view pulls together a focused set of listings where deadline information is present, so you can compare options without sorting through unrelated results first. The programs below span areas such as education, STEM, medicine, humanities, and community-focused awards, with study levels that can include graduate and high school applicants as well as adult learners. Award amounts vary by listing, and requirements do too: some entries may ask for essays, while others appear lighter-touch. Because deadline wording differs across rows and some dates can be relatively close, it makes sense to apply early and verify every detail on the official scholarship page before you commit time to an application.
